control.description: Measured raster-vs-GL floor on inventory preview pose1 (parked mouse, empty inv) after pin + arm-Z fix. J-vs-J noise was exactly 0 (bit-identical A/B). Residual is soft lighting/filtering plus 2 hard silhouette pixels; not an arbitrary +1.0 margin.

gate.headroom_note: mean_allowance = measured pose1 mean * 1.25 (0.15763*1.25≈0.197); hard_px_cap covers fill-rule silhouette budget at this ROI size
